verses.original: Κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί οὐ ἦλθον καθ’ ὑπεροχὴν λόγου ἢ σοφίας καταγγέλλων ὑμῖν τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kagō elthōn pros hymas adelphoi ou ēlthon kath’ hyperochēn logou ē sophias katangellōn hymin to martyrion tou Theou
verses.literal: [When] I came to you brothers vvv I did not come with eloquence . . . or wisdom [as] I proclaimed to you the testimony - about God

verses.original: γὰρ ἔκρινά εἰδέναι οὐ τι ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μὴ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν καὶ τοῦτον ἐσταυρωμένον
verses.transliteration: gar ekrina eidenai ou ti en hymin ei mē Iēsoun Christon kai touton estaurōmenon
verses.literal: For I resolved to know nothing . . . [while I was] with you except . . . Jesus Christ and Him crucified

verses.original: κἀγὼ ἐγενόμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ καὶ ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἐν πολλῷ τρόμῳ
verses.transliteration: kagō egenomēn pros hymas en astheneia kai en phobō kai en pollō tromō
verses.literal: I came to you in weakness and - fear and with much trembling

verses.original: καὶ μου ὁ λόγος καὶ μου τὸ κήρυγμά οὐκ ἐν πειθοῖς λόγοις σοφίας ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀποδείξει Πνεύματος καὶ δυνάμεως
verses.transliteration: kai mou ho logos kai mou to kērygma ouk en peithois logois sophias all’ en apodeixei Pneumatos kai dynameōs
verses.literal: - My - message and my - preaching [were] not with persuasive words of wisdom but with a demonstration of [the] Spirit’s - power

verses.original: ἵνα ὑμῶν ἡ πίστις μὴ ᾖ ἐν ἀνθρώπων σοφίᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν Θεοῦ δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: hina hymōn hē pistis mē ē en anthrōpōn sophia all’ en Theou dynamei
verses.literal: so that your - faith vvv would not rest on men’s wisdom but on God’s power

verses.original: ἐν τοῖς τελείοις δὲ λαλοῦμεν Σοφίαν δὲ οὐ σοφίαν τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐδὲ τῶν ἀρχόντων τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν καταργουμένων
verses.transliteration: en tois teleiois de laloumen Sophian de ou sophian toutou tou aiōnos oude tōn archontōn toutou tou aiōnos tōn katargoumenōn
verses.literal: Among the mature however we speak a message of wisdom but not [the] wisdom of this - age [or] of the rulers of this - age who are coming to nothing

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λαλοῦμεν ἐν μυστηρίῳ τὴν ἀποκεκρυμμένην σοφίαν Θεοῦ ἣν ὁ Θεὸς προώρισεν εἰς ἡμῶν δόξαν πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: alla laloumen en mystēriō tēn apokekrymmenēn sophian Theou hēn ho Theos proōrisen eis hēmōn doxan pro tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: No we speak of vvv [the] mysterious - [and] hidden wisdom of God which - [He] destined for our glory before - time [began]

verses.original: οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀρχόντων τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος ἔγνωκεν ἣν γὰρ εἰ ἔγνωσαν ἂν οὐκ ἐσταύρωσαν τὸν Κύριον τῆς δόξης
verses.transliteration: oudeis tōn archontōn toutou tou aiōnos egnōken hēn gar ei egnōsan an ouk estaurōsan ton Kyrion tēs doxēs
verses.literal: None of the rulers of this - age understood [it] For if they had vvv vvv they would not have crucified the Lord - of glory

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Ἃ οὐκ ὀφθαλμὸς εἶδεν καὶ οὐκ οὖς ἤκουσεν καὶ οὐκ καρδίαν ἀνέβη ἐπὶ ἀνθρώπου ὅσα ὁ Θεὸς ἡτοίμασεν τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alla kathōs gegraptai Ha ouk ophthalmos eiden kai ouk ous ēkousen kai ouk kardian anebē epi anthrōpou hosa ho Theos hētoimasen tois agapōsin auton
verses.literal: Rather as it is written - No eye has seen - no ear has heard - no heart has imagined . . . . . . what - God has prepared for those who love Him

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς ἀπεκάλυψεν Ἡμῖν διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος γὰρ Τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐραυνᾷ πάντα καὶ τὰ βάθη τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos apekalypsen Hēmin dia tou Pneumatos gar To Pneuma erauna panta kai ta bathē tou Theou
verses.literal: But - God has revealed [it] to us by the Spirit - The Spirit searches all things even the deep [ things ] - of God

verses.original: γὰρ τίς ἀνθρώπων οἶδεν τὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰ μὴ τὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πνεῦμα τὸ ἐν αὐτῷ οὕτως καὶ οὐδεὶς ἔγνωκεν τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰ μὴ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar tis anthrōpōn oiden ta tou anthrōpou ei mē to tou anthrōpou pneuma to en autō houtōs kai oudeis egnōken ta tou Theou ei mē to Pneuma tou Theou
verses.literal: For who among men knows the [thoughts] - of man except . . . vvv vvv [his own] spirit - within him So too no one knows the [thoughts] - of God except . . . the Spirit - of God

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς ἐλάβομεν οὐ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα εἰδῶμεν τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ χαρισθέντα ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis elabomen ou to pneuma tou kosmou alla to pneuma to ek tou Theou hina eidōmen ta hypo tou Theou charisthenta hēmin
verses.literal: - We have not received . . . the spirit of the world but the Spirit who [is] from - God that we may understand what - - God has freely given us

verses.original: καὶ ἃ λαλοῦμεν οὐκ ἐν λόγοις διδακτοῖς ἀνθρωπίνης σοφίας ἀλλ’ ἐν διδακτοῖς Πνεύματος συνκρίνοντες πνευματικὰ πνευματικοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ha laloumen ouk en logois didaktois anthrōpinēs sophias all’ en didaktois Pneumatos synkrinontes pneumatika pneumatikois
verses.literal: And [this is] [what] we speak not in words taught [us] by human wisdom but in [words] taught by [the] Spirit expressing spiritual truths in spiritual [words]

verses.original: δὲ Ψυχικὸς ἄνθρωπος οὐ δέχεται τὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Θεοῦ γὰρ ἐστίν μωρία αὐτῷ καὶ οὐ δύναται γνῶναι ὅτι πνευματικῶς ἀνακρίνεται
verses.transliteration: de Psychikos anthrōpos ou dechetai ta tou Pneumatos tou Theou gar estin mōria autō kai ou dynatai gnōnai hoti pneumatikōs anakrinetai
verses.literal: - [The] natural man {does} not accept the things that come from the Spirit - of God For they are foolishness to him and vvv he cannot understand [them] because {they are} spiritually discerned

verses.original: δὲ ὁ πνευματικὸς ἀνακρίνει τὰ πάντα δὲ αὐτὸς ἀνακρίνεται ὑπ’ οὐδενὸς
verses.transliteration: de ho pneumatikos anakrinei ta panta de autos anakrinetai hyp’ oudenos
verses.literal: - The spiritual [man] judges - all things but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment . . . . . .

verses.original: γὰρ Τίς ἔγνω νοῦν Κυρίου ὃς συμβιβάσει αὐτόν δὲ ἡμεῖς ἔχομεν νοῦν Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar Tis egnō noun Kyriou hos symbibasei auton de hēmeis echomen noun Christou
verses.literal: For who has known [the] mind of [the] Lord [so as] to instruct Him But we have [the] mind of Christ
